description: Carta de potencial solar de Lisboa is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Lisboa E-Nova. Carta que permite identificar o potencial solar para todos os edifícios de Lisboa. Coverage: Lisboa E-Nova. The publisher named on the listing is Lisboa E-Nova. Its keywords include climate, sustentabilidade, energia, sustainability, sun, buildings. The listing shows 3 download or service links in TIFF, PNG. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-zero). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
